description: Points du canevas géodésique de m2A is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Mulhouse Alsace Agglomération. Set of support points, materialized by a landmark in the field, whose planimetric coordinates (X,Y) and altitudes are precisely determined in the reference systems RGF93-CC48 and NGF-IGN69. Data map: Visualization - Points of the m2A geodetic canvas The points of the geodetic canvas are used to carry out topographical work. Coverage: Mulhouse Alsace Agglomération. The portal shows the English title as "Points of the m2A geodetic canvas" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Mulhouse Alsace Agglomération. Its keywords include geodesie, gnss, gps, territoire, canevas. The listing shows 4 download or service links in CSV, JSON, ZIP. The listing shows 2026-03-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
